headline.VN: Giờ Ai Là Người Cả Tin Hả?!

text.EN: HAHA! I got you good, didn't I?
text.SP: ¡JAJA! Realmente caíste en mi treta, ¿verdad?

text.EN: I made both you and dad think the Tooth Nymph was real!
text.SP: ¡Hice que tú y papá creyeran que la Ninfa de los Dientes es real!

text.EN: Oh... That's a specific kind of heartbreak I haven't felt in awhile...
text.SP: Ay... Esa es una forma de romper mi corazón muy específica que no había sentido en mucho tiempo.

text.EN: Well played, Pipi... Consider me bamboozled.
text.SP: Bien jugado, Pipi... Considerame engañado.

text.EN: Big baby! That's what you adults get for constantly telling me silly, fake stories to get me to do things I don't wanna do.
text.SP: ¡Grandioso! Eso es lo que ustedes adultos ganan por andarme contando sus tontas y ridículas historias para hacer que haga cosas que no quiero hacer.

text.EN: I don't even know why dad made the Tooth Nymph up. What good would putting teeth under a pillow do?
text.SP: Ni siquiera sé por qué papá inventó a la Ninfa de los Dientes. ¿De qué sirve jalar dientes de abajo de una almohada?

text.EN: That's what you adults get for constantly telling me silly, fake stories to get me to do things I don't wanna do.
text.SP: ¡Grandioso! Eso es lo que ustedes adultos ganan por andarme contando sus tontas y ridículas historias para hacer que haga cosas que no quiero hacer.

text.EN: I don't even know why dad made the Tooth Nymph up. What good would putting teeth under a pillow do?
text.SP: Ni siquiera sé por qué papá inventó a la Ninfa de los Dientes. ¿De qué sirve jalar dientes de abajo de una almohada?

text.EN: Your dad just wanted to spice up your life, Pipi... You gave him an existential crisis in return...
text.SP: Tu papá sólo quería endulzar tu vida un poco, Pipi... A cambio le diste una crisis existencial...

text.EN: It was so funny seeing dad freak out over a thing that doesn't exist.
text.SP: Fue tan graciosos ver a papá asustarse tanto por una cosa que no existe.

text.EN: Maybe it was a little mean, though... I hope I'm still on Santa's Nice List.
text.SP: Aunque quizá haya sido demasiado... espero que todavía me encuentre en la lista buena de Santa.

text.EN: Hmm...
text.SP: Hmm...

text.EN: Why're you 'hmming' me?
text.SP: ¿Por qué me estás "hmmm"eando?

text.EN: Ohhhh. You must be wondering about the big sack of carrots!
text.SP: Aaayyy. ¡Seguro te estás preguntando sobre el gran saco de zanahorias!

text.EN: Here's my secret, Tsuki: I made it! It's just an arts and crafts project!
text.SP: Aquí mi secreto, Tsuki: ¡Yo lo hice! ¡Es sólo un proyecto de mis manualidades!

text.EN: No way. It looked so convincing.
text.SP: No te creo. Se veía demasiado convincente.

text.EN: I knooow, right?! Aaand that's why I'm thinking of giving it to you.
text.SP: ¡Ya lo sseeeeeee! yyyyy por eso es que quiero regalartelo.

text.EN: It looks a little too real. I don't want any trouble with the feds.
text.SP: Se ve demasiado real. No quiero problemas con la policía.

text.EN: What?! I mean, okay, thanks???
text.SP: ¿Qué? Digo... este... ¿gracias?

text.EN: No problem, Tsuki! Ahh... That was such a good prank.
text.SP: ¡No hay problema, Tsuki! Ahhh... Que buena broma fue esa.

text.EN: Ah... I don't even wanna talk about it...
text.SP: Ay... Ni siquiera quiero hablar de eso...

text.EN: We really thought the Tooth Nymph was real, huh...
text.SP: Realmente pensábamos que la Ninfa de los Dientes era real, ¿eh?
Yo...

text.EN: Yes... we really did.
text.SP: Sí... realmente lo creíamos.

headline.ptBR: Roncos Quebrando Recorde!?
headline.VN: Kỷ Lục Về Tiếng Ngáy?!

subheadline.EN: This decibel count will SHOCK you
subheadline.ptBR: Os decibéis vão te CHOCAR.
subheadline.VN: Số Đo Decibel Này Sẽ Làm Bạn SỐC

text.EN: Haaah... What a shame.
text.SP: Jaaaaa... Que lástima...

text.EN: What's the latest with ol' Benny here?
text.SP: ¿Que hay de nuevo con el gran Benny hoy?

text.EN: Aww, you seem sad. Why's that?
text.SP: Aww, te ves triste. ¿Qué pasa?

text.EN: Well.
text.SP: Puessss...

text.EN: Let me start from the be-beginning.
text.SP: A ver... por do-donde empiezo...

text.EN: It started with Momo submitting many, MANY complaints about Bobo snoring in his cart.
text.SP: Todo comenzó con Momo presentando muchas, MUCHAS, quejas acerca de los ronquidos de Bobo en su carreta.

text.EN: I checked it out, and yes. He was snoring. BUT-!
text.SP: Y fuí a checarlo... y pues sí. Estaba roncando. ¡PEEEERO!

text.EN: It was the loudest snores I-I've ever heard in my life. And I know snores.
text.SP: Eran los ronquidos más ru-ruidosos que he escuchado en mi vida. Y mira que sé de ronquidos.

text.EN: Why would you know about sno... Nevermind, then what?
text.SP: Cómo es que sabes de... olvídalo, ¿luego qué?

text.EN: Still waiting for this story to pick up...
text.SP: Sigo esperando a que esto se ponga bueno...

text.EN: Okay, so I brought my sound-level meter the next time I was there at night.
text.SP: Bueno, pues me llevé mi medidor de volúmen la siguiente noche que fuí.

text.EN: A hundred and fifteen deci...decibels, Tsuki. That's almost as loud as a car horn.
text.SP: Ciento quince deci... decibeles, Tsuki. Es casi tan alto como un claxon.

text.EN: I checked what the world record for 'Loudest Snore' is and Bobo totally smashes it!
text.SP: ¡Investigué cuál es el record mundial de "Ronquido Ruidoso" y Bobo definitivamente le gana!

text.EN: I was just about to fill out the documents to off-officially contest the record when Bobo angrily admonished me for publishing the article I put out today.
text.SP: Estaba a punto de llenar los formatos para oficialmente concursar por el record cuando Bobo entró furioso a regañarme por publicar el artículo de hoy.

text.EN: Oh yeah, I saw him. He was mega pissed.
text.SP: Ay sí, lo ví. Estaba mega enojadísimo.

text.EN: Ohh. Okay, soo...
text.SP: Ohhh.... Ok, pues...

text.EN: Urgh... R-really? He still is?
text.SP: Urgh... ¿E-en serio? ¿Todavía?

text.EN: See, so I can't invite any adju-ad... adjudicators if Bobo isn't willing to cooperate.
text.SP: Ves... así que no puedo invitar adju-ad... adjudicadores si Bobo no está dispuesto a cooperar.

text.EN: Tsu-Tsuki! Our village could have been the proud owner of a world record..!
text.SP: ¡Tsu-Tsuki! ¡Nuestra aldea hubiera podido ser la orgullosa poseedora de un record mundial!

text.EN: Not only is Bobo angry with me but... the world record could have been good for the village...
text.SP: No sólo Bobo está enojado conmigo pero... el record mundial puedo haber sido oro puro para la aldea...

text.EN: I can't invite any adju-ad...adjudicators if Bobo isn't willing to cooperate.
text.SP: No puedo invitar adju-ad... adjudicadores si Bobo no está dispuesto a cooperar.

text.EN: Tsu-Tsuki! Our village could have been the proud owner of a world record..!
text.SP: ¡Tsu-Tsuki! ¡Nuestra aldea hubiera podido ser la orgullosa poseedora de un record mundial!

text.EN: It would have been good for the village...
text.SP: Hubiera sido buenísimo para la aldea...

text.EN: Imagine the tourism we'd have if our village was a world record holder...
text.SP: Imagínate todo el turismo que tendríamos si nuestra aldea tuviera el record mundial...

text.EN: You really think people will come here to watch some guy snore?
text.SP: ¿De verdad crees que la gente vendrá a ver a un desconocido roncar?

text.EN: Bobo would be so angry if he heard you talking about him like he's some walking amenity...
text.SP: Bobo se enojaría como nunca si te escuchara hablando sobre él como si fuera una amenidad andante...

text.EN: Maybe... There are enthusiasts for almost evey... everything out there, Tsuki.
text.SP: Quizá... hay entusiastas para casi to... todo allá afuera, Tsuki.

text.EN: That's why I'm confiding in you and not him...
text.SP: Por eso es que estoy confiandotelo a ti y no a él...

text.EN: Bah! Never a moment of peace in this village...
text.SP: ¡Bah! Nunca hay un momento de paz en este pueblo...

text.EN: Oh great, what do you want from me?!
text.SP: Ay, genial... ¿Qué quieres de mí?

text.EN: Uhm. Ramen? Why're you so mad?
text.SP: Eh... ¿Un ramen? ¿Por qué estás tan enfadado?

text.EN: So he talks loud and snores loud too!
text.SP: ¡Así que habla fuerte y ronca fuerte también!

text.EN: It's that stupid daily paper. That tanuki guy used a fancy device to measure... something about my snores.
text.SP: Es ese estúpido diario. Ese tipo tanuki utilizó un aparato sofisticado para medir... algo sobre mis ronquidos.

text.EN: Without my consent! How unimaginably rude!
text.SP: ¡Sin mi consentimiento! ¡Qué grosería tan inimaginable!

text.EN: What's a panda gotta do to get some respect in this village?!
text.SP: ¡¿Qué tiene que hacer un panda para conseguir algo de respeto en este pueblo?!

text.EN: Don't make me hit you with my pan, you!
text.SP: ¡Tú! ¡No me hagas golpearte con mi sartén!

text.EN: That paper shouldn't have been published to begin with. A total breach of privacy, I tell you!
text.SP: Ese periódico ni siquiera debería haberse publicado. ¡Una violación total de la privacidad, te lo digo!

text.EN: Just 'cuz I ain't living in a fancy home like the rest of you fools it don't mean you've got free reign to use fancy devices to record... measure... whatever the hell that thing does!
text.SP: El hecho de que no viva en una casa elegante como el resto de ustedes tontos, no significa que tengan la libertad de utilizar aparatos sofisticados para registrar... medir... ¡lo que sea que haga esa cosa!

text.EN: You're pretty pressed about people hearing you snore for someone who snores openly in the middle of town.
text.SP: Estás demasiado preocupado de que la gente te oiga roncar, para ser alguien que ronca abiertamente en pleno centro de la aldea.

text.EN: Why, you little...
text.SP: ¿Cómo te a...?

text.EN: Are you trying to get blacklisted from my restaurant?
text.SP: ¿Acaso quieres que te incluya en la lista negra de mi restaurante?

text.EN: Ah. That does sound a little annoying.
text.SP: Ah. Eso suena un poco molesto.

text.EN: You get me, ya?
text.SP: ¿Pero me entiendes, no?

text.EN: I feed this village and all I get for it is humiliation...
text.SP: Alimento a esta aldea y lo único que obtengo a cambio es humillación...

headline.ptBR: O Que É O Que É...
headline.VN: Đố Vui, Đố Mẹo!

subheadline.EN: Challenge your intellect…if you dare!
subheadline.ptBR: Desafie seu intelecto... se você se atreve!
subheadline.VN: Hãy Thử Thách Trí Tuệ Của Bạn…Nếu Bạn Dám!

text.EN: Ah, here comes a challenger... Meehheheehehehee..!
text.SP: Ah, llega un digno competidor... Meejejejeejejeee!

text.EN: What fresh hell is this voice you're doing?
text.SP: ¿Qué carajos traes con esa voz que estás haciendo?

text.EN: Oh no. You're about to riddle me.
text.SP: Ay no. Estás a punto enredarme en un acertijo.

text.EN: Come on, Tsuki. Don't tell me you haven't read The Puzzle Peddler?
text.SP: Vamos, Tsuki. No me digas que no has leído "El Rompecabezas Ambulante".

text.EN: The lead character is this heartthrob swashbuckler, who exclusively talked in riddles.
text.SP: El personaje principal es este espadachín robacorazones que habla exclusivamente en acertijos.

text.EN: You could say... I'm a little enamored with the character.
text.SP: Podrías decir que... tengo un pequeño amorío con ese personaje.

text.EN: Oh, come on, Tsuki. You'd be excited if you read The Puzzle Peddler too...
text.SP: Ay, vamos, Tsuki. Te emocionarías si leyeras El Rompecabezas Ambulante también...

text.EN: The lead character is this heartthrob swashbuckler, who exclusively talked in riddles.
text.SP: El personaje principal es este espadachín robacorazones que habla exclusivamente en acertijos.

text.EN: You could say... I'm a little enamored with the character.
text.SP: Podrías decir que... tengo un pequeño amorío con ese personaje.

text.EN: So you like this riddle guy and are now just dishing out riddles to everyone against their will.
text.SP: Así que ahora te gusta este acertijo de hombre y te la pasas aventándole acertijos a todo mundo en contra de su voluntad.

text.EN: Yup!
text.SP: Sip!

text.EN: So riddle the first:
text.SP: Acertijo aquí:

text.EN: I come from the treetops, and am a friend to all apes. Should you find me, you could even bake me into bread! What am I..?
text.SP: Vivo en las copas de los árboles y soy amigo de todos los simios. Si es que me encuentras, ¡hasta podrías hornearme en pan! ¿Quién soy?

text.EN: Huh... I don't know, Chi...
text.SP: Huh... No lo sé, Chi...

text.EN: Uhh.
text.SP: Uhh.

text.EN: Bread???
Why, I'm a banana!
text.SP: Pues... ¡soy un plátano!

text.EN: ...did you think of that riddle yourself?
text.SP: ¿Se te ocurrió eso solita?

text.EN: Of course! Why?
text.SP: ¡Por supuesto! ¿Por?

text.EN: Yep. I can tell.
text.SP: Obvio. Se nota.

text.EN: Oho! I will take that as a compliment!
text.SP: ¡Aja! ¡Tomaré eso como un cumplido!

text.EN: I've got more Chi originals if you wanna scratch that brain of yours a little more!
text.SP: ¡Tengo más originales de Chi si quieres rascarle a tu cerebro un poquito más!

text.EN: Okay, here's another riddle for you:
text.SP: Va, aquí tienes otro acertijo:

text.EN: Tom has six bananas, Robin has three bananas, Zoe has two mangoes, and Zoey has six mangoes. How many mangoes does Zoey have?
text.SP: Tom tiene seis plátanos, Robin tiene tres plátanos, Zoe tiene dos mangos y Zoey tiene seis mangos. ¿Cuántos mangos tiene Zoey?

text.EN: Six. She'd have six mangoes.
text.SP: Seis. Debe tener seis mangos.

text.EN: Why do your riddles always involve bananas?
text.SP: ¿Por qué tus acertijos siempre son sobre plátanos?

text.EN: Bzzt! You're wrong!
text.SP: ¡Bzzt! ¡Estás mal!

text.EN: It's eight! Zoe and Zoey are sisters!
text.SP: ¡Son ocho! ¡Zoe y Zoey son hermanas!

text.EN: ...this riddle sucks.
text.SP: ... este acertijo apesta.

text.EN: Hey, I'm the one asking questions here!
text.SP: ¡Oye, yo soy quien hace las preguntas aquí!

text.EN: Here it is again: Tom has six bananas, Robin has three bananas, Zoe has two mangoes, and Zoey has six mangoes. How many mangoes does Zoey have?
text.SP: Aquí va de nuevo: Tom tiene seis plátanos, Robin tiene tres plátanos, Zoe tiene dos mangos y Zoey tiene seis mangos. ¿Cuántos mangos tiene Zoey?

text.EN: Uhm, sore loser much? You just have to be better at solving riddles.
text.SP: Uhm, malísimo perdedor, ¿eh? Sólo tienes que ser mejor resolviendo acertijos.

text.EN: I'm full of riddles! Have another:
text.SP: ¡Estoy llena de acertijos! Aquí va otro:

text.EN: Which of these words is the odd one out? 'Apple', 'eagle', or 'banana'?
text.SP: ¿Cuál de estas palabras está fuera de lugar? Manzana, Águila, Plátano.

text.EN: Uhm. Eagle..?
text.SP: Aaamm... ¿Águila?

text.EN: Wrong!
text.SP: ¡Tache!

text.EN: It's banana!
text.SP: ¡Es plátano!

text.EN: Apple and eagle both end with an 'e', but banana doesn't!
text.SP: Manzana y Águila ambas terminan en "a", ¡plátano no!

text.EN: Your riddles don't make sense at all!
text.SP: ¡Tus acertijos no tienen nada de sentido!

text.EN: Oh, don't just say that because I outsmarted you!
text.SP: ¡Ay, no digas eso sólo porque soy mejor que tú en eso!

headline.ptBR: Enigma é o Baralho!
headline.VN: Đố Cái CON KHỈ!

subheadline.EN: Anyone can do this shit.
subheadline.ptBR: Qualquer um pode fazer essa merda.
subheadline.VN: Ai Cũng Có Thể Giải Mấy Thứ Nhảm Nhí Đó.

text.EN: Myheheheh. Care to get your riddle game on?
text.SP: Miejejeje. ¿Te gustaría enredarte en un acertijo?

text.EN: Well, I don't care what you want. I'm going to riddle you anyway!
text.SP: Equis, no me importa lo que quieras. ¡Te enredaré de todas maneras!

text.EN: Wow. Are you a Puzzle Peddler mega fan too?
text.SP: Wow. ¿También eres mega fan de "El Rompecabezas Ambulante"?

text.EN: Oh, HELL no. Don't even jokingly suggest I'd be into the same books as her!!!
text.SP: Ay, definitivamente NO. ¡Ni siquiera sugieras de broma que me gustan los mismos libros que ella!

text.EN: Consider this revenge. She wouldn't stop babbling about how she's such a master riddler, so I'm gonna sling some riddles your way.
text.SP: Considera esto una venganza. No para de alardear sobre cómo es una acertijera experta, así que voy a sacar acertijos porque sí.

text.EN: One, to prove her wrong; two, to mock her.
text.SP: Uno, para demostrar que soy mejor; dos, para molestarla.

text.EN: Anyway. Riddle me piss:
text.SP: Equis, resuélveme esta mierda:

text.EN: I have lakes with no water, mountains with no stone, and cities with no buildings. What am I?
text.SP: Tengo ríos sin agua, montañas sin piedras y ciudades sin edificios. ¿Qué soy?

text.EN: No, please... I'm not strong enough to do this again...
text.SP: No, por favor... no tengo la fuerza suficiente para hacer esto de nuevo...

text.EN: That's just too bad. Riddle me piss:
text.SP: Que malo. Resuélveme esta mierda:

text.EN: I have lakes with no water, mountains with no stone, and cities with no buildings. What am I?
text.SP: Tengo ríos sin agua, montañas sin piedras y ciudades sin edificios. ¿Qué soy?

text.EN: Oh... That's a headscratcher. What?
text.SP: Ay... ya me dolió la cabeza. ¿Qué?

text.EN: What, come on think a little harder.
text.SP: Vamos, piensa un poco más.

text.EN: I'm a map. Duh.
text.SP: Soy un mapa. Duh.

text.EN: Oh..! That's a really good one, Moca. You're very good at this riddle thing!
text.SP: ¡Oh! Ese es uno muy bueno, Moca. ¡De verdad eres muy bueno en los acertijos!

text.EN: NO! I'm not!!!
text.SP: ¡NO! ¡¡¡No lo soy!!!

text.EN: Riddles are inane. And acting like some kinda... some kinda... riddler is even more stupid.
text.SP: Los acertijos son tonterías. Y actuar como un... un...acertijero es aún más estúpido.

text.EN: Your single riddle is, like, way better than all of Chi's ones combined. Are you sure you're not a Puzzle Peddler fan?
text.SP: Tu único acertijo es, por mucho, mejor que todos los de Chi combinados. ¿Seguro que no eres fan del Rompecabezas Ambulante?

text.EN: STOP IT!!! Ew!
text.SP: ¡QUE NO! ¡Ew!

text.EN: I'm not a nerd! And I'm not a riddle savant!
text.SP: ¡No soy ñoño! ¡Y no soy ningún conocedor de acertijos!

headline.EN: I Deserve to Have a Phone
headline.ptBR: Eu Mereço Ter Um Telefone.
headline.VN: Tôi Xứng Đáng Có Một Chiếc Điện Thoại

text.EN: The time is now, Tsuki.
text.SP: Ya es hora, Tsuki.

text.EN: Sign my petition!
text.SP: ¡Firma mi demanda!

text.EN: Okay. You've got a pen? And where do I sign?
text.SP: Va. ¿Tienes una pluma? ¿Dónde firmo?

text.EN: Oh! Uhm, I don't actually have any pen or papers. I'm just saying things.
text.SP: ¡Ay! Uhm, de hecho no tengo plumas ni papeles. Sólo ando de habladora.

text.EN: You don't even wanna hear my case?
text.SP: ¿No quieres al menos escuchar mi caso?

text.EN: Some context, please?
text.SP: ¿Poquito de contexto, porfa?

text.EN: Look around you, everyone in Mushroom Village has a phone.
text.SP: Mira a tu alrededor, todos en Villa Hongo tienen un teléfono.

text.EN: But ME!
text.SP: ¡Y YO NO!

text.EN: Don't you think that's a little unfair? What if I get lost? How will I map my way home?
text.SP: ¿No crees que eso es algo injusto? ¿Qué tal que me pierdo? ¿Cómo encontraré el camino a casa?

text.EN: Fiiine. Okay, what's your case?
text.SP: Bueeeeeno. Va, ¿cuál es tu caso?

text.EN: There's no way you'd get lost in our little village. Moot point.
text.SP: No hay forma de que te pierdas en nuestra pequeña aldea. Mal argumento.

text.EN: Okay! Fine! Moot! Whatever that means!
text.SP: ¡Ok! ¡Va! ¡Argumento! ¡Lo que sea que eso signifique!

text.EN: You know the internet is the greatest source of information, right?
text.SP: Sí sabes que el internet es la más grande fuente de información, ¿verdad?

text.EN: You guys suck if you're keeping such a big thing of information from me!
text.SP: ¡Todos ustedes apestan si me prohiben estar cerca de toda esa cosa de la información!

text.EN: Hmm. Counterpoint: there's also a looot of misinformation on the internet. Can't have you thinking the Earth is flat or something, now can we?
text.SP: Hmm. Por otro lado: también hay un mooooonton de desinformación en el internet. No podemos tenerte creyendo que la Tierra es plana o algo así, ¿o sí?

text.EN: Oh, boy. There's a lot of stuff on the internet young eyes REALLY shouldn't see.
text.SP: Ay, Dios. Hay muchísimas cosas en el internet que ojos infantes DE VERDAD no deberían ver.

text.EN: But... It is flat. What other freaking shape could it be?!
text.SP: Pero... es plana. ¿De que otra tonta forma podría ser?

text.EN: Anyway, my third point is that I want a phone to call people. Y'know, the main purpose of a phone?
text.SP: Equis, mi tercer punto es que quiero un teléfono para llamar a la gente. Tú sabes, ¿el verdadero propósito de un teléfono?

text.EN: Like what? Un-aliving?
text.SP: ¿Cómo qué? ¿Desvivición?

text.EN: I know what un-alive is, Tsuki. I will be fine on the internet.
text.SP: Yo sé lo que es la desvivición es, Tsuki. Estaré bien en el internet.

text.EN: Nope. Nope, but go on if you've got more to say.
text.SP: Nope. Nope, pero continúa si tienes algo más que decir.

text.EN: Anyway, my third point is that I want a phone to call people. Y'know, the main purpose of a phone?
text.SP: Equis, mi tercer punto es que quiero un teléfono para llamar a la gente. Tú sabes, ¿el verdadero propósito de un teléfono?

text.EN: Just... go to them and talk to them. I do that. Way more fun.
text.SP: Solo... ve a donde estén y habla con ellos. Yo hago eso. Mucho más divertido.

text.EN: Graaah! You sound just like dad!
text.SP: ¡Graaaah! ¡Suenas justo como papá!

text.EN: Sigh. I'll just have to save up a lotta carrots and buy my own phone.
text.SP: *Suspiro* Voy a tener que ahorrar muchas zanahorias y comprar mi propio teléfono.

text.EN: Good day, Tsuki!!!
text.SP: ¡Buen día, Tsuki!

text.EN: Ah, Tsuki. Did you see today's paper?
text.SP: Ah, Tsuki. ¿Has visto el periódico de hoy?

text.EN: Uhhh, I can't remember if I did.
text.SP: Uhhh, no recuerdo si lo vi.

text.EN: Pipi's quite the journalist.
text.SP: Pipi es una gran periodista.

text.EN: Well, it's just Pipi petitioning to the whole of Mushroom Village for a phone of her own.
text.SP: Bueno, es solo Pipi pidiendo a toda Villa Hongo un teléfono propio.

text.EN: Her grammar and vocabulary are a lot better than mine was when I was her age.
text.SP: Su gramática y vocabulario son mucho mejores que los míos cuando tenía su edad.

text.EN: I'm proud of her... but I'm still not getting her a phone.
text.SP: Estoy orgullosa de ella... pero todavía no le voy a comprar un teléfono.

text.EN: She is, isn't she?
text.SP: Sí que lo es, de verdad.

text.EN: I appreciate the drive, but she really can be so dramatic, heheh. I can't be too mad at her- Miyabi would have found the whole thing really funny.
text.SP: Aprecio el interés, pero realmente puede ser muy dramática, jejeje. No puedo enojarme demasiado con ella, Miyabi habría encontrado todo el asunto muy divertido.

text.EN: That kid always finds new ways to make me smile... but I'm still not getting her a phone.
text.SP: Esa niña siempre encuentra nuevas formas de hacerme sonreír... pero todavía no le voy a comprar un teléfono.

letterText.EN: Your continued patronage is deeply appreciated!

letterText.VN: Chúng tôi vô cùng trân trọng sự ủng hộ liên tục của bạn!

letterText.EN: We packed this one special for you!
letterText.VN: Chúng tôi đã gói kiện hàng này đặc biệt dành riêng cho bạn!

letterText.EN: Every parcel from Plank & Stone is carefully packaged with love!
letterText.ptBR: Cada encomenda da Tabua & Pedra é embalada cuidadosamente com amor!
letterText.VN: Mỗi bưu kiện từ Plank & Stone đều được đóng gói cẩn thận và đầy tình yêu thương

letterText.EN: This one came all the way from Anchor City!
letterText.ptBR: Este aqui veio diretamente da Cidade da Ancora!
letterText.VN: Cái này đến từ tận Thành phố Anchor xa xôi!

letterText.EN: Don't you love it when your order arrives early? Or late? We're not actually sure when this will arrive...
letterText.ptBR: Você não ama quando seu pedido chega mais cedo? Ou tarde? Nós não temos muita certeza de quando isso vai chegar...
letterText.VN: Bạn có thích không khi đơn hàng của mình được giao sớm hơn dự kiến? Hoặc trễ hơn? Chúng tôi cũng không chắc khi nào nó sẽ đến...

letterText.EN: This one's straight from the factory!
letterText.ptBR: Este aqui veio direto da fábrica!
letterText.VN: Sản phẩm này được lấy thẳng từ nhà máy!

letterText.EN: No refunds! It's very clearly stated in our Terms of Service!
letterText.ptBR: Sem devoluções! Esta claramente listado em nossos Termos de Serviço!
letterText.VN: Không hoàn tiền! Điều này được nêu rất rõ trong Điều khoản dịch vụ của chúng tôi!

letterText.EN: [Write a letter about how much you value the customer's continued support. Use flowery language to keep them coming back. Give it that personal touch so they feel like the letter was written specially for them.]
letterText.ptBR: [Escreva uma carta sobre o quanto você valoriza o apoio contínuo dos clientes. Use uma linguagem florida para faze-los continuarem voltando. De aquele toque pessoal para eles sentirem que a carta foi feita especialmente para eles.]
letterText.VN: [Viết một lá thư bày tỏ sự trân trọng của bạn đối với sự ủng hộ liên tục của khách hàng. Sử dụng ngôn từ hoa mỹ để giữ chân họ. Hãy thêm chút cảm xúc cá nhân để họ cảm thấy lá thư được viết riêng cho họ.]

letterText.EN: Yo, grandma! I got a new job packing boxes and shit, haha! Your boy out here eatin!!! in some warehouse called plank and rock or something. Anyway, see ya next week, love ya gam gam!
letterText.ptBR: E aí, vó! Tô num trampo novo aqui embalando caixas e tals, hahaha! Seu mlk aqui tá voando alto!!! Tô num galpão chamado pau e pedra ou qualquer coisa assim. Enfim, até semana que vem, te amo veinha!
letterText.VN: Này bà! Cháu mới xin được việc đóng thùng các thứ, haha! Thằng bé nhà bà đang hưởng thụ đây này!!! Trong cái nhà kho tên là plank and rock hay gì đó. Thôi, hẹn gặp lại bà tuần sau nhé, yêu bà lắm!

letterText.EN:
[Rerouted: Delivered erroneously to the wrong address.]

Note: typo in addressee, it's tsuki not sooki.
letterText.VN:
[Đã chuyển hướng: Kiện hàng được giao nhầm địa chỉ.]

Lưu ý: lỗi đánh máy ở phần người nhận, là tsuki chứ không phải sooki.

letterText.EN: Sorry I couldn't make it for your birthday, grandma. Pulling extra shifts at the warehouse, gotta get that bread, ya know how it is. The hustle never ends hahaha. Anyway, Mom's on my case about going back to school again and I'm like ugh, let ya boy be ya know??? I swear, only you understand me, grandma! Love ya, gam gam!
letterText.VN: Xin lỗi nhưng cháu không thể đến dự sinh nhật bà được. Cháu còn phải tăng ca ở kho, phải kiếm cho đủ sống. Bà biết mà, công việc bận rộn chẳng bao giờ kết thúc hahaha. Dù sao thì, mẹ đang nhắc cháu về việc đi học lại, và cháu kiểu - ôi, để con yên đi! Cháu thề là chỉ có bà hiểu cháu thôi, bà ạ! Yêu bà lắm!

letterText.EN:
[Detained For Suspicious Content]

Note: bob, it's just some crappy furniture, please stop tagging every parcel as suspicious.

[Released by Customs]
letterText.VN:
[Bị Giữ Lại Do Có Dấu Hiệu Đáng Ngờ]

Ghi chú: Bob, đó chỉ là mấy món nội thất tồi tàn thôi, làm ơn đừng dán nhãn đáng ngờ lên mọi kiện hàng nữa.

[Đã được miễn trừ bởi Cơ Quan Chức Trách]

letterText.EN:
[Detained For Suspicious Content]

Note: bob, buddy,  you gotta stop tagging every parcel as suspicious.

[Released by Customs]
letterText.VN:
[Bị Giữ Lại Do Có Dấu Hiệu Đáng Ngờ]

Ghi chú: Này, Bob, cậu thật sự nên dừng việc dán nhãn đáng ngờ lên mọi kiện hàng đi.

[Đã được miễn trừ bởi Cơ Quan Chức Trách]

letterText.EN: If you enjoyed your purchase, please leave a review on our website!
letterText.VN: Nếu bạn thích sản phẩm mình mua, vui lòng để lại đánh giá trên trang web của chúng tôi!

letterText.EN: Are you gettin my letters, grandma? Ain't gotten a reply from ya in a while, got ya boy feeling a little worried. Work's gettin really boring, might listen to Mom and give the school thing a shot again. But, ya know, money's tight, and I'm pretty stupid, don't wanna flunk out again. Anyway, I'll see ya soon, as soon as I can take some time off work.
letterText.VN: Bà có nhận được thư của cháu không? Lâu rồi cháu không nhận được thư trả lời của bà, cháu hơi lo lắng. Công việc chán ngắt, có lẽ cháu sẽ nghe lời mẹ và thử lại chuyện học hành. Nhưng bà biết đấy, tiền bạc eo hẹp, mà cháu thì ngốc lắm, không muốn bị đuổi học lần nữa. Dù sao thì, cháu sẽ sớm gặp lại bà, ngay khi cháu có thể nghỉ làm một thời gian.

letterText.EN:
[Detained by Customs]

Note: fire bob please

[Released by Customs]
letterText.VN:
[Bị Giữ Lại Do Có Dấu Hiệu Đáng Ngờ]

Ghi chú: Làm ơn hãy đuổi việc bob.

[Đã được miễn trừ bởi Cơ Quan Chức Trách]

letterText.EN: welp, looks like I'm getting fired by the warehouse. They were talking all kindsa stuff about me tampering with customer deliveries? NO IDEA what the hell they're on. I'll be by next week, miss you gam gam.
letterText.VN: chà, hình như kho hàng sắp đuổi việc cháu rồi. Họ cứ nói đủ thứ chuyện về việc cháu can thiệp vào hàng hóa của khách hàng? CHẢ BIẾT họ đang nghĩ cái quái gì. Tuần sau cháu sẽ đến, nhớ bà lắm.

letterText.EN:
[Order Damaged In Transit]

Note: Small chip on the bottom, cosmetic damage not covered by insurance.
letterText.VN:
[Đơn hàng bị hư hỏng trong quá trình vận chuyển]

Lưu ý: Có vết sứt nhỏ ở đáy, hư hỏng bề mặt không được bảo hiểm chi trả.

letterText.EN: [Loyal Customer: Customer has purchased multiple furniture and requires a specialized message with their order.]
letterText.VN: [Khách hàng trung thành: Khách hàng đã mua nhiều đồ nội thất và yêu cầu một tin nhắn chuyên biệt kèm theo đơn đặt hàng của họ.]

letterText.EN:
[Do Not Ship: Item Suffered Minor Damage In Transit]

Note: Damage is within quality assurance standards. Continuing shipment procedures.
letterText.VN:
[Yêu Cầu Không Giao hàng: Sản phẩm bị hư hỏng nhẹ trong quá trình vận chuyển]

Lưu ý: Thiệt hại nằm trong tiêu chuẩn đảm bảo chất lượng. Quy trình vận chuyển vẫn đang được tiếp tục.

letterText.EN:
[Item Lost In Facility]

[Item Found]

Note: Item was being used by employees at the warehouse. Disciplinary action has been carried out.
letterText.VN:
[Vật Phẩm Biến Mất Tại Cơ Sở Đóng Gói]

[Vật Phẩm Đã Được Tìm Thấy]

Lưu ý: Vật phẩm đã qua sử dụng của nhân viên nhà kho. Biện pháp kỷ luật đã được thi hành.

orderInitialLine.VN: Kiện hàng của bạn đã được giao!
